title: 二叉树的锯齿形层序遍历
prompt:
Use case: infographic-diagram.
Asset type: One complete static Chinese algorithm explanation image for Bamboo Copter's dark desktop app. The user finds the old animation abstract; make the algorithm concrete and understandable on this single image.
Style: refined modern editorial educational infographic, flat precise diagrams, crisp Chinese sans-serif typography, balanced whitespace, readable labels. Landscape around 3:2. Deep charcoal background #171b20, warm white text, muted grey secondary text, restrained mint and amber accents. Main algorithm diagram occupies most of the canvas. Thin accurate arrows, small clean step numbers, distinguish indexes from values. No glossy 3D, mascot, decorative illustration, dashboard widgets, fake app window, play buttons, watermarks or full solution code. No excessive nested cards or huge empty areas. Use visual steps connected in reading order. ALL examples, indexes, formulas and Chinese labels below must be accurate and readable. Render only the specified content, with short explanatory Chinese labels; do not invent additional numerical examples. Main title top left, input directly underneath, 3-4 visual sections, and a compact complexity footer. The result should be visible immediately and the intermediate steps must explain how it was obtained.

Title: "103  二叉树的锯齿形层序遍历". Subtitle: "队列照常向前, 只改变每层结果的写入方向".
Input text exactly "root = [3,9,20,null,null,15,7]".
Upper left visual section ① "同一棵树, 三层输出": exact binary tree root 3, left child 9, right child 20; node 20 has left child 15 and right child 7. Exactly 5 nodes and 4 tree edges. Layer labels "第 0 层", "第 1 层", "第 2 层". Three subtle direction arrows beside levels: layer0 left→right, layer1 right→left, layer2 left→right. Output result immediately visible to right of tree: "返回 [[3],[20,9],[15,7]]". Tree arrows must show parent-child relations only, not queue traversal.
Upper right section ② "FIFO 顺序始终不变": clearly show three compact queue rows with left front marker "队首" and right back marker "队尾". Layer0 queue [3] -> pop3; enqueue left9 then right20 -> next queue [9,20]. Layer1 queue [9,20] -> pop9 then20; only20 has children, enqueue left15 then right7 -> next queue [15,7]. Layer2 queue [15,7] -> pop15 then7 -> queue[]. Put concise invariants "每层先固定 size, 只出队 size 次" and "孩子始终左先右后入队".
Lower left section ③ "交替的是结果位置": simple table with columns "层", "出队顺序", "写入位置", "本层结果". Rows exactly: "0" | "3" | "i" | "[3]"; "1" | "9 → 20" | "size - 1 - i" | "[20,9]"; "2" | "15 → 7" | "i" | "[15,7]". The table should be uncluttered and all columns legible.
Lower right section ④ "反向层: 9 先出队, 却写在后面": show size=2. Step1 "i=0: 9 写入位置 1" with two result cells indexed 0,1 and values "待填",9. Step2 "i=1: 20 写入位置 0" with two result cells indexed 0,1 and values20,9. Direction arrow only from chronological step1 to step2, never imply9 is pushed after20 or reverse queue. Highlight result[20,9] in restrained amber, ordinary queue mint. Explain "层结束后切换方向". Include "空树 → []" small.
Compact footer exact "时间 O(n)   辅助空间 O(w)   返回结果 O(n)" and "n 为节点数, w 为最大层宽; 队列和单层数组最多占 O(w), 最坏 O(n)".
Constraints: This is a single complete Chinese educational raster infographic at landscape 3:2. Accuracy over decoration. Do not reverse child enqueue order. Do not mix the next layer's children into the current layer. Do not say BFS queue is traversed right-to-left. No executable solution code. Text crisp, all 5 values correct, no additional tree nodes.

review.steps: 项目实际 PNG 中树为 3→9/20、20→15/7, 共五节点四边. 队列固定 size 为 1/2/2, 普通 FIFO 出队顺序为 3、9→20、15→7, 孩子依次左后右入队. 第二层 size=2, i=0 的 9 写下标 1, i=1 的 20 写下标 0; 只交替每层结果位置, 不反转队列.
review.complexity: 各节点入队、出队及写入各一次, 时间 O(n). 队列和单层数组辅助空间 O(w), w 为最大层宽, 最坏 O(n); 返回结果 O(n) 单列.
review.text: 官方 ImageGen 原生生成 1536×1024. 查看项目实际 PNG 确认中文、输入、输出、队首队尾、公式 size-1-i、下标 0/1、层编号 0/1/2、箭头和复杂度均清晰且准确, 无需定点编辑.
